about: I am a Senior Lecturer in the School of Computing and Information Systems at the University of Melbourne. I hold a Masters and PhD in Computer Science from the Federal University of Pernambuco (Brazil). Since the beginning of my teaching career I have been actively building relationships and working with universities, technology clusters, innovation institutes, government agencies and private companies to promote authentic and innovative teaching and learning practices. In 2022 I won the Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology (FEIT) Excellence Award in Teaching and Learning – The Kelvin Medal; in 2023 I received the University-wide Edward Brown Award for Teaching Excellence. In 2024 I was awarded the University of Melbourne GEM Scott Teaching Fellowship, which recognises the University's distinguished educational leaders and is based on a program of work.

During my scientific studies, which began in 2006, I worked with computer scientists, designers, educators and psychologists in educational contexts. My work was, and is, focused on teaching and researching artificial intelligence applied to online learning and engineering education. In 2013, my PhD was awarded Best PhD Thesis by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC) at the Congress on Computers in Education.

Since 2016 I have worked with the Faculty of Education, the Assessment Research Centre and the Melbourne Centre for the Study of Higher Education on artificial intelligence in online teaching and learning. My expertise is in using artificial intelligence to model and assist tertiary students in digital learning environments. I combine machine learning and natural language processing with models of self-regulated learning. I am particularly interested in: (i) understanding how tertiary students learn independently, and how and when we can best support them; (ii) supporting students' technical and professional skills through evidence-based explainable AI; and (iii) authorship verification and stylometry for academic integrity.

Parallel to my research, I worked for 12 years as a Specialist System Engineer and Technical Consultant at CESAR (Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil), twice awarded the most innovative IT institute in Brazil, researching, leading and developing for Motorola, Samsung, Compal Electronics, Gemalto and other international projects.
